chapter.title: Create: Combat
chapter.subtitle: Start with the Revolver and follow the chain

quests.title: Revolver
quests.subtitle: Your first gun
description: A Revolver is your first steampunk firearm, crafted at a Gunsmithing Table.
Next: a Flintlock for a classic single-shot.

quests.title: Flintlock
quests.subtitle: Classic single-shot
description: A Flintlock is a single-shot firearm with a long barrel for accuracy.
Next: a Gatling for heavy firepower.

quests.title: Gatling
quests.subtitle: Heavy firepower
description: A Gatling gun delivers rapid sustained fire. Craft it with Create machines.
Next: an Iron Sight to aim better.

quests.title: Iron Sight
quests.subtitle: Aim better
description: An Iron Sight attaches to your gun for better accuracy.

quests.title: Paper Cartridge
quests.subtitle: Ammunition
description: Paper Cartridges are the ammo for your firearms. Stock up.
Next: a Cannon Mount for artillery.

quests.title: Cannon Mount
quests.subtitle: Artillery for defense
description: A Cannon Mount holds a Big Cannon. Place cannons at your colony perimeter for defense.
Next: Solid Shot for cannon ammo.

quests.title: Solid Shot
quests.subtitle: Cannon ammunition
description: Solid Shot is the basic cannon projectile - high penetrating force against structures.

quests.title: Bayonet
quests.subtitle: Melee attachment
description: A Bayonet attaches to your gun for melee combat.

quests.title: HE Shell
quests.subtitle: Explosive cannon ammo
description: An HE Shell explodes with more force than TNT for demolishing structures.
